gloss: to lean on; to feel heavy (stomach)

definitions.gloss: to lean on; to rest against
definitions.explanation: To support one's body by leaning against something or someone.

definitions.gloss: to feel heavy; to sit heavily (stomach)
definitions.explanation: To have a heavy, uncomfortable feeling in the stomach after eating.

examples.japanese: {椅子|いす}の{背|せ}もたれに{凭|もた}れる。
examples.english: To lean against the back of a chair.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{壁|かべ}に{凭|もた}れて{立|た}っていた。
examples.english: He was standing leaning against the wall.

examples.japanese: {油|あぶら}っこいものを{食|た}べて{胃|い}が{凭|もた}れている。
examples.english: My stomach feels heavy from eating greasy food.

notes:
{凭|もた}れる has two distinct meanings: the physical action of leaning and the sensation of stomach heaviness.

CONJUGATION (ichidan verb):
- {凭|もた}れる (dictionary form)
- {凭|もた}れない (negative)
- {凭|もた}れた (past)
- {凭|もた}れて (te-form)

KANJI NOTE:
The kanji {凭|もた} is rarely used in modern writing; this word is often written in hiragana as もたれる.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {胃|い}にもたれる: to sit heavily on the stomach
- {背|せ}もたれ: backrest (of a chair)
